parameters.content:
## W41 SMC broker lead notice (routed, not booked), 24 Oct 2026
Every 5 minutes: SortMyCover leads routed to an adviser at least SMC_BROKER_LEAD_NOTICE_GRACE_MIN (10) minutes ago, inside 7 days, not test data, not opted out, not disqualified, with no live booking and no notice yet.
- Claim first: ONE lead_activities row per lead (broker_notified_routed, key w41:broker_routed:<lead>, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING). Only the rows inserted this tick are sent; a lead is told about once.
- Sends: WhatsApp template broker_lead_routed through smc-whatsapp-send (honours DRY_RUN_SENDS; skips while the template has no Content SID; W22 on failure) + a plain-text email from SortMyCover through smc-email-send.
- The grace keeps a client who books straight away to ONE adviser message (W05 broker_new_booking). A later booking still sends broker_new_booking as before.
- POPIA: the adviser's own number and email, the client's first name + last initial, origin and times. Never the client's number or email, ID numbers or message text.
Env: SMC_BROKER_LEAD_NOTICE_ENABLED=true (anything else: nothing runs), SMC_BROKER_LEAD_NOTICE_GRACE_MIN, PORTAL_BASE, LINDI_RELAY_TOKEN, SUPABASE_FUNCTIONS_URL, DRY_RUN_SENDS.

parameters.query:
-- W41 SMC broker lead notice: SortMyCover leads routed to an adviser at least $2 minutes ago (inside 7 days), not test data,
-- not opted out, not disqualified, with no live booking and no notice yet. Only what the message needs leaves the database.
SELECT l.id AS lead_id, l.brand_id, l.broker_id, l.routed_at, l.created_at, l.consent_at, l.origin, l.is_synthetic,
       split_part(btrim(coalesce(l.first_name, '')), ' ', 1) AS first_name,
       left(btrim(coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(l.last_name, '')), ''), split_part(btrim(coalesce(l.first_name, '')), ' ', 2))), 1) AS last_initial,
       split_part(btrim(coalesce(b.adviser_name, b.contact_person, '')), ' ', 1) AS adviser_first,
       coalesce(b.adviser_whatsapp, b.whatsapp_number) AS broker_whatsapp,
       b.email AS broker_email,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities p
                WHERE p.lead_id = l.id AND p.activity_type LIKE 'start_page_%' AND p.activity_type <> 'start_page_pending') AS opened_page,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM public.lead_activities nn WHERE nn.lead_id = l.id AND nn.activity_type = 'nurture_sent') AS nudges
  FROM public.leads l
  JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = l.broker_id
 WHERE l.brand_id = $1::uuid
   AND l.routed_at IS NOT NULL
   AND l.routed_at <= now() - make_interval(mins => $2::int)
   AND l.routed_at > now() - interval '7 days'
   AND l.opted_out_at IS NULL
   AND l.disqualified_reason IS NULL
   AND coalesce(l.is_synthetic, false) = false
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments a
                    WHERE a.client_id = l.id AND a.status IN ('booked', 'confirmed', 'rescheduled', 'attended', 'no_show'))
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities d WHERE d.idempotency_key = 'w41:broker_routed:' || l.id::text)
 ORDER BY l.routed_at
 LIMIT $3::int;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
SELECT r.lead_id, r.brand_id, r.broker_id, 'W41', 'system', 'broker_notified_routed', r.payload, now(), r.key
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(lead_id uuid, brand_id uuid, broker_id uuid, key text, payload jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING lead_id;
